extension_summary.authority: only active_ids may enter the current Developer objective

implied_completion: Invalid, expired, and reused link tokens route to the same recoverable expired-link state as the paste path, matching PRD section 8 email action pages.
Verification via link consumes the EmailToken exactly once, matching section 4.2 single-use expiring-token semantics.
Scheme registration persists for the desktop test session so repeated replays are deterministic; bundled registration matters only if bundling is enabled later.
Only the token value is extracted from the delivered URL and passed to the verify command; malformed links fail safely without side effects.
mandatory_objectives: The literal follow-the-link verification route from PRD section 3 step 3 works on a stock desktop for both warm and cold activation.
The paste-the-link fallback in VerifyEmailView remains functional and discoverable.
The complete PRD section 3 first-run path stays completable with durable data so the prd_golden_path qualitative review can pass.
The preserved native launch chain, white-box auth/persistence tests, and least-privilege security posture are retained; any deep-link permissions are minimal and the CSP is unchanged.
Tokens and private email contents stay redacted from logs and evidence per PRD section 10.
task_specification.objective: Make the PRD section 3 step-3 follow-the-link route literal: activating the emailed focusboard:// verification link on a stock desktop returns the user to the application with the single-use token consumed, while preserving the paste-the-link fallback, validated auth/persistence behavior, least-privilege security posture, and visual direction, so gap:prd_golden_path can be closed by the golden-path review.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate generates focusboard://auth/verify?token=... links (src-tauri/src/lib.rs VERIFY_BASE constant) but registers no OS-level URL-scheme handler: src-tauri/Cargo.toml contains no deep-link plugin, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json has no deep-link or scheme configuration, and no capabilities are declared. On a stock desktop, activating the emailed verification link therefore never reaches the running application, and verification only completes through the paste-the-link fallback in the VerifyEmailView. PRD section 3 step 3 explicitly requires receiving the verification email, following the link, and returning to the application for the release-critical path.

stop_conditions: If the host replay sandbox cannot activate an external scheme link (no xdg-open or desktop-entry path available), report the deep-link route as blocked with the paste fallback still verified rather than fabricating a runtime receipt.
If registering the handler requires weakening the CSP or granting broad Tauri capabilities, stop and surface the security tradeoff instead of breaking the preserved least-privilege posture.
If deep-link delivery cannot be made observable through the registered runtime contract, report unknown rather than claiming follow-the-link success from unit tests alone.
If the scheme change breaks the fresh clean build or the white-box test suite, repair the regression before handoff or report blocked.

strategy.rationale: Repair the one literal gap in PRD section 3 step 3 by making the emailed verification link return to the application, which addresses this loop's only active host-pinned product finding and keeps the release-critical first-run path completable so the unverified prd_golden_path review can run against a defect-free candidate.

A fresh clean npm and cargo build exits 0, and any new link-token parsing has unit coverage for malformed, expired, and reused tokens.
runtime: Host native replay drives register, mail-sink email delivery, external focusboard:// activation while the app is running, and confirms verification completed with the paste field untouched.
A cold-start replay activates the link with no instance running and captures the app reaching the verified state.
A replay activates a reused token link and captures the recoverable expired-link state.
visual: Captured post-activation states show the verify or signed-in shell preserving the calm editorial auth direction with no prohibited visual patterns.
Captured evidence redacts token values from visible link strings where the runtime allows.

done_when: On a stock desktop, activating the mail-sink verification email's focusboard://auth/verify link from outside the running app focuses it and completes verification with the token consumed exactly once.
Activating the same link when no instance is running launches Focusboard directly into the verify-completed state without requiring the paste field.
The paste-the-link fallback still completes verification and remains visible in the VerifyEmailView.
A reused or expired token delivered by link shows the recoverable expired-link message and the shell stays navigable.
A fresh clean npm and cargo build exits 0, the window still launches titled Focusboard, and the existing white-box test suite passes unchanged.
No token or email secret appears in application logs or captured evidence, and the CSP string in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is unchanged.
tasks.instructions: Make the emailed verification link literally work per PRD section 3 step 3: activating focusboard://auth/verify?token=... from outside the app on a stock desktop session must return the user to the application with the single-use token consumed and the account verified. Register the URL-scheme handler at the OS level using any approach consistent with the Tauri runtime contract, wire the delivered link into the existing verify route in src/App.tsx, and keep VerifyEmailView's paste-the-link field working as the documented fallback in src/auth/AuthViews.tsx. Handle both warm activation (app already running: focus the existing instance and route it to verify) and cold activation (app launched by the link: boot to the verified state). Reused, expired, or malformed link tokens must land in the recoverable expired-link state, never a crash. Preserve all validated behavior: the white-box cargo test suite passes, a fresh clean build exits 0, the CSP string is unchanged, any new Tauri permissions remain least-privilege, and tokens never reach logs or screenshots. Do not implement reminder-email task links and do not touch deferred ledger issues.

risk_note.summary: OS-level scheme registration is environment-dependent (dev session versus bundled desktop-entry contexts), so the likeliest insufficient_evidence outcome is a replay that cannot prove an external link activation returned to the application.
risk_note.validation: Native replay drives an external focusboard:// activation (warm and cold) against the local mail-sink message and captures the resulting application state; a unit-test-only pass must not be reported as runtime success.
risk_note.why_now: find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered is this loop's single active, host-pinned product finding and gap:prd_golden_path is unverified, leaving the release-critical first-run path with a known literal gap.
